body.x: Joy Drone will showcaseindustrial drones and one-handed drone controllers at CES 2019, the world'slargest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, from January 8 (Tue) to January 11(Fri).

Joy Drone, which was founded inDecember 2016, is working to develop industrial drones and the world's firstone-handed drone controllers to become a global company. The company developedUAV as vertical takeoff and landing (VTOL), it has been verified in Russian andMalaysian markets by solving the restriction of takeoff and landing space,increasing the number of flight times by 3 times compared with other productsand 4 times of competitors in flying distance.

Features include: ▲ Operate in 3Gor worse communication area where signals are interrupted ▲ 3 times flight timecompared to existing products ▲ 4 times fly distance compared to existingproducts ▲ 4 times payload compared to existing products ▲ Due to verticaltakeoff and landing And solve space constraints. ▲ Various industries can beutilized through various options.
